attributes.name: ram_gb
attributes.description: Minimum RAM required in GB. Return a number.

attributes.name: storage_gb
attributes.description: Minimum SSD storage required in GB. Convert TB to GB using 1 TB = 1024 GB. Return a number.

attributes.name: budget_inr
attributes.description: Maximum customer budget in Indian rupees. Return a number without currency symbols.

attributes.name: use_case
attributes.description: The customer's intended laptop use, such as programming, gaming, or general work. Return null if not specified.

attributes.name: budget_text
attributes.description: The budget exactly as the customer wrote it, e.g. "80k" or "under 1 lakh". Empty if none.

attributes.name: ram_text
attributes.description: The RAM requirement exactly as written, e.g. "16 GB" or "high ram". Empty if none.

attributes.name: storage_text
attributes.description: The storage requirement exactly as written, e.g. "1 TB". Empty if none.

attributes.name: quantity_text
attributes.description: How many laptops they want, as written, e.g. "one". Empty if none.

attributes.name: brand
attributes.description: A brand name if mentioned. Empty if none.

parameters.query:
SELECT *
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (product_name, price_inr)
    product_name,
    price_inr,
    ram_gb,
    storage_gb,
    storage_type,
    processor,
    operating_system
  FROM public.laptops
  WHERE ram_gb >= $1::INTEGER
    AND storage_gb >= $2::INTEGER
    AND price_inr <= $3::NUMERIC
    AND ($5::TEXT = 'any' OR product_name ILIKE '%' || $5::TEXT || '%')
  ORDER BY product_name, price_inr
) AS unique_laptops
ORDER BY ram_gb DESC, price_inr DESC
LIMIT $4::INTEGER;

parameters.content: One-time data load: downloads the open-source laptop CSV, cleans it, and inserts it into Neon. Already run. Do not re-run (would duplicate rows).
Customer support flow: email → extract requirements → SQL search → reply
